additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380084-DC/Si-D/SE [UyJhM6] Broken CMS on dispenser on delivery. CRM:00645000774
additional_info.body:
Hi Magnus,
Hope you're doing fine.
Could you please confirm the following:
1. Has the rope stopping mechanism already been removed from the CMS?
2. Is the rope stuck in the rollers?
If the rope is stuck in the rollers or the rollers are stuck, please replace the roll cross set.
If the rollers are functioning properly but the rope box is not retracting the rope, then the rope box needs to be replaced.
Below are the MLFBs for the spare parts:
1. CMS Roll Cross Set of 2
: 8EM5905-0AA01-0AA3
2. Cable Management System Rope Box left
: 8EM5905-0AA00-7AA3
3. Cable Management System Rope Box right
: 8EM5905-0AA00-7AA4
Please refer the document for the CMS installation/ repair:
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/attachments/109826814/cms_installation_manual_1.6.pdf?download=true
Thank you
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
